Description: PROPOSAL ONLY. Native CloudFormation, no transform/IAM changes. Existing ZIP; five receive resources with consumer disabled.
TemplateBody:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: MuseRelay AWS Engagement Bridge - isolated WhatsApp transport, no Core deployment
Parameters:
  BindingsJson:
    Type: String
    Description: JSON bindings; no credentials. Topic ARN must match InboundTopic output.
    Default: '[]'
  SocialPhoneArn:
    Type: String
    AllowedPattern: ^$|arn:aws:social-messaging:eu-west-1:365470560685:phone-number-id/[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9-]*
    Default: ''
  SecretArn:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional dedicated Core-direction signing secret using the default Secrets Manager key; empty creates
      an unpopulated secret. No secret values.
    AllowedPattern: ^$|arn:aws:secretsmanager:eu-west-1:365470560685:secret:muserelay-aws-bridge-stage/signing-[A-Za-z0-9]{6}$
    Default: ''
  CoreBaseUrl:
    Type: String
    AllowedPattern: ^$|https://aws-bridge-staging\.muserelay\.com
    Default: ''
  MetaApiVersion:
    Type: String
    AllowedPattern: ^$|v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+
    Description: Explicit version supported by AWS Social at deployment time
    Default: ''
  LiveSend:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
    - 'false'
    - 'true'
  RunId:
    Type: String
    Default: phase4_not_started
    AllowedPattern: phase4_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{4,56}
  DailySendLimit:
    Type: Number
    Default: 6
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 6
  DailyInboundLimit:
    Type: Number
    Default: 6
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 6
  KmsAdministratorArn:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
    - arn:aws:iam::365470560685:role/muserelay-aws-bridge-stage-cfn-execution
    Description: Existing stable IAM CloudFormation service role. Also select this role in stack Permissions. Do
      not use AWSReservedSSO roles.
  DeployProcessing:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
    - 'false'
    - 'true'
    Description: Requires separate authorization. Default false; does not modify the MuseRelay Core.
  ProcessingEnabled:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
    - 'false'
    - 'true'
    Description: Requires separate authorization. Default false; does not modify the MuseRelay Core.
  RuntimeArtifactKey:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: ^$|releases/[a-f0-9]{40}/bridge\.zip
    Description: Private S3 key uploaded after approval to this stack ArtifactBucket. No URL or secret.
  KmsRecoveryAdministratorArn:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
    - arn:aws:iam::365470560685:role/muserelay-aws-bridge-kms-recovery
    Description: Existing stable IAM recovery role from separately authorized IAM foundation; retain while the KMS
      key exists.
  ReceiveEnabled:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
    - 'false'
    - 'true'
    Description: Explicit inbound-only consumer authorization
  SendEnabled:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
    - 'false'
    - 'true'
    Description: Explicit outbound processing authorization
  DeployOutbound:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
    - 'false'
    - 'true'
    Description: Create outbound API, functions and queues; not required for reception
  InboundExecutionRoleArn:
    Type: String
    Default: arn:aws:iam::365470560685:role/muserelay-aws-bridge-stage-inbound-runtime
    AllowedValues:
    - arn:aws:iam::365470560685:role/muserelay-aws-bridge-stage-inbound-runtime
    Description: Pre-created, separately reviewed runtime IAM foundation role; no credentials
  EnqueueExecutionRoleArn:
    Type: String
    Default: arn:aws:iam::365470560685:role/muserelay-aws-bridge-stage-enqueue-runtime
    AllowedValues:
    - arn:aws:iam::365470560685:role/muserelay-aws-bridge-stage-enqueue-runtime
    Description: Pre-created, separately reviewed runtime IAM foundation role; no credentials
  SenderExecutionRoleArn:
    Type: String
    Default: arn:aws:iam::365470560685:role/muserelay-aws-bridge-stage-sender-runtime
    AllowedValues:
    - arn:aws:iam::365470560685:role/muserelay-aws-bridge-stage-sender-runtime
    Description: Pre-created, separately reviewed runtime IAM foundation role; no credentials
  OutboundSecretArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: ^$|arn:aws:secretsmanager:eu-west-1:365470560685:secret:muserelay-aws-bridge-stage/signing-outbound-[A-Za-z0-9]{6}$
    Description: Optional dedicated outbound HMAC secret; never the inbound/Core signing secret
Rules:
  ScreenArtDemo:
    Assertions:
    - Assert:
        Fn::Equals:
        - Ref: AWS::AccountId
        - '365470560685'
      AssertDescription: Screen Art account only.
    - Assert:
        Fn::Equals:
        - Ref: AWS::Region
        - eu-west-1
      AssertDescription: Ireland only.
    - Assert:
        Fn::Equals:
        - Ref: AWS::StackName
        - muserelay-aws-bridge-stage
      AssertDescription: Use the reviewed stack name to preserve the SNS topic and queue identities.
  RuntimeInputs:
    RuleCondition:
      Fn::Equals:
      - Ref: DeployProcessing
      - 'true'
    Assertions:
    - Assert:
        Fn::Not:
        - Fn::Equals:
          - Ref: SocialPhoneArn
          - ''
      AssertDescription: Runtime deployment requires SocialPhoneArn
    - Assert:
        Fn::Not:
        - Fn::Equals:
          - Ref: CoreBaseUrl
          - ''
      AssertDescription: Runtime deployment requires CoreBaseUrl
    - Assert:
        Fn::Not:
        - Fn::Equals:
          - Ref: BindingsJson
          - '[]'
      AssertDescription: Supply real, initially disabled demo bindings.
    - Assert:
        Fn::Not:
        - Fn::Equals:
          - Ref: RuntimeArtifactKey
          - ''
      AssertDescription: Upload the reviewed runtime ZIP before updating processing resources.
  ProcessingRequiresRuntime:
    RuleCondition:
      Fn::Equals:
      - Ref: ProcessingEnabled
      - 'true'
    Assertions:
    - Assert:
        Fn::Equals:
        - Ref: DeployProcessing
        - 'true'
      AssertDescription: Runtime must be deployed before processing is enabled.
  SendingRequiresProcessing:
    RuleCondition:
      Fn::Equals:
      - Ref: LiveSend
      - 'true'
    Assertions:
    - Assert:
        Fn::Equals:
        - Ref: ProcessingEnabled
        - 'true'
      AssertDescription: Sending requires an explicitly enabled runtime.
  ReceiveEnabledPrerequisites:
    RuleCondition:
      Fn::Equals:
      - Ref: ReceiveEnabled
      - 'true'
    Assertions:
    - Assert:
        Fn::Equals:
        - Ref: DeployProcessing
        - 'true'
      AssertDescription: ReceiveEnabled requires DeployProcessing
    - Assert:
        Fn::Equals:
        - Ref: ProcessingEnabled
        - 'true'
      AssertDescription: ReceiveEnabled requires ProcessingEnabled
  SendEnabledPrerequisites:
    RuleCondition:
      Fn::Equals:
      - Ref: SendEnabled
      - 'true'
    Assertions:
    - Assert:
        Fn::Equals:
        - Ref: DeployProcessing
        - 'true'
      AssertDescription: SendEnabled requires DeployProcessing
    - Assert:
        Fn::Equals:
        - Ref: DeployOutbound
        - 'true'
      AssertDescription: SendEnabled requires DeployOutbound
    - Assert:
        Fn::Equals:
        - Ref: ProcessingEnabled
        - 'true'
      AssertDescription: SendEnabled requires ProcessingEnabled
  LiveSendPrerequisites:
    RuleCondition:
      Fn::Equals:
      - Ref: LiveSend
      - 'true'
    Assertions:
    - Assert:
        Fn::Equals:
        - Ref: DeployProcessing
        - 'true'
      AssertDescription: LiveSend requires DeployProcessing
    - Assert:
        Fn::Equals:
        - Ref: DeployOutbound
        - 'true'
      AssertDescription: LiveSend requires DeployOutbound
    - Assert:
        Fn::Equals:
        - Ref: ProcessingEnabled
        - 'true'
      AssertDescription: LiveSend requires ProcessingEnabled
    - Assert:
        Fn::Equals:
        - Ref: SendEnabled
        - 'true'
      AssertDescription: LiveSend requires SendEnabled
  DeployOutboundPrerequisites:
    RuleCondition:
      Fn::Equals:
      - Ref: DeployOutbound
      - 'true'
    Assertions:
    - Assert:
        Fn::Equals:
        - Ref: DeployProcessing
        - 'true'
      AssertDescription: DeployOutbound requires DeployProcessing
  OutboundInputs:
    RuleCondition:
      Fn::Equals:
      - Ref: DeployOutbound
      - 'true'
    Assertions:
    - Assert:
        Fn::Not:
        - Fn::Equals:
          - Ref: MetaApiVersion
          - ''
      AssertDescription: Runtime deployment requires MetaApiVersion
Resources:
  SnsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Screen Art MuseRelay staging SNS events; dedicated hackathon key
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      EnableKeyRotation: false
      PendingWindowInDays: 7
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
        - Sid: DedicatedKeyAdministration
          Effect: Allow
          Principal:
            AWS:
              Ref: KmsAdministratorArn
          Action:
          - kms:DescribeKey
          - kms:GetKeyPolicy
          - kms:PutKeyPolicy
          - kms:EnableKey
          - kms:EnableKeyRotation
          - kms:DisableKeyRotation
          - kms:GetKeyRotationStatus
          - kms:ListResourceTags
          - kms:TagResource
          - kms:UntagResource
          - kms:UpdateKeyDescription
          - kms:CreateAlias
          - kms:UpdateAlias
          - kms:DeleteAlias
          Resource: '*'
        - Sid: DedicatedRecoveryAdministrator
          Effect: Allow
          Principal:
            AWS:
              Ref: KmsRecoveryAdministratorArn
          Action:
          - kms:DescribeKey
          - kms:GetKeyPolicy
          - kms:PutKeyPolicy
          Resource: '*'
        - Sid: AccountPolicyRecovery
          Effect: Allow
          Principal:
            AWS:
              Fn::Sub: arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
          Action:
          - kms:DescribeKey
          - kms:GetKeyPolicy
          - kms:PutKeyPolicy
          Resource: '*'
        - Sid: AllowScreenArtSocialPublishEncryption
          Effect: Allow
          Principal:
            Service: social-messaging.amazonaws.com
          Action:
          - kms:GenerateDataKey*
          - kms:Decrypt
          Resource: '*'
          Condition:
            StringEquals:
              aws:SourceAccount:
                Ref: AWS::AccountId
            ArnLike:
              aws:SourceArn:
                Fn::Sub: arn:aws:social-messaging:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*
      Tags:
      - Key: Company
        Value: ScreenArt
      - Key: Project
        Value: MuseRelay
      - Key: Component
        Value: aws-engagement-bridge
      - Key: Environment
        Value: staging
      - Key: Purpose
        Value: hackathon
      BypassPolicyLockoutSafetyCheck: false
  SnsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName:
        Fn::Sub: alias/${AWS::StackName}-sns
      TargetKeyId:
        Ref: SnsKey
  InboundTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName:
        Fn::Sub: ${AWS::StackName}-inbound
      FifoTopic: false
      KmsMasterKeyId:
        Fn::GetAtt:
        - SnsKey
        - Arn
      MaximumMessageSize: 262144
      Tags:
      - Key: Company
        Value: ScreenArt
      - Key: Project
        Value: MuseRelay
      - Key: Component
        Value: aws-engagement-bridge
      - Key: Environment
        Value: staging
      - Key: Purpose
        Value: hackathon
  TopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics:
      - Ref: InboundTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
        - Effect: Allow
          Principal:
            Service: social-messaging.amazonaws.com
          Action: sns:Publish
          Resource:
            Ref: InboundTopic
          Condition:
            StringEquals:
              aws:SourceAccount:
                Ref: AWS::AccountId
            ArnLike:
              aws:SourceArn:
                Fn::Sub: arn:aws:social-messaging:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*
  State:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
      - AttributeName: pk
        AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
      - AttributeName: pk
        KeyType: HASH
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        AttributeName: expiresAt
        Enabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      Tags:
      - Key: Company
        Value: ScreenArt
      - Key: Project
        Value: MuseRelay
      - Key: Component
        Value: aws-engagement-bridge
      - Key: Environment
        Value: staging
      - Key: Purpose
        Value: hackathon
      TableName:
        Fn::Sub: ${AWS::StackName}-state
    Condition: DeployRuntime
  InboundDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      SqsManagedSseEnabled: true
      QueueName:
        Fn::Sub: ${AWS::StackName}-inbound-dlq
      RedriveAllowPolicy:
        redrivePermission: byQueue
        sourceQueueArns:
        - Fn::Sub: arn:aws:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${AWS::StackName}-inbound-queue
      Tags:
      - Key: Company
        Value: ScreenArt
      - Key: Project
        Value: MuseRelay
      - Key: Component
        Value: aws-engagement-bridge
      - Key: Environment
        Value: staging
      - Key: Purpose
        Value: hackathon
  OutboundDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      SqsManagedSseEnabled: true
      QueueName:
        Fn::Sub: ${AWS::StackName}-outbound-dlq
      RedriveAllowPolicy:
        redrivePermission: byQueue
        sourceQueueArns:
        - Fn::Sub: arn:aws:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${AWS::StackName}-outbound-queue
      Tags:
      - Key: Company
        Value: ScreenArt
      - Key: Project
        Value: MuseRelay
      - Key: Component
        Value: aws-engagement-bridge
      - Key: Environment
        Value: staging
      - Key: Purpose
        Value: hackathon
    Condition: DeployOutboundRuntime
  InboundQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      VisibilityTimeout: 180
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 345600
      SqsManagedSseEnabled: true
      RedrivePolicy:
        deadLetterTargetArn:
          Fn::GetAtt:
          - InboundDlq
          - Arn
        maxReceiveCount: 5
      QueueName:
        Fn::Sub: ${AWS::StackName}-inbound-queue
      Tags:
      - Key: Company
        Value: ScreenArt
      - Key: Project
        Value: MuseRelay
      - Key: Component
        Value: aws-engagement-bridge
      - Key: Environment
        Value: staging
      - Key: Purpose
        Value: hackathon
  OutboundQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      VisibilityTimeout: 180
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 345600
      SqsManagedSseEnabled: true
      RedrivePolicy:
        deadLetterTargetArn:
          Fn::GetAtt:
          - OutboundDlq
          - Arn
        maxReceiveCount: 5
      QueueName:
        Fn::Sub: ${AWS::StackName}-outbound-queue
      Tags:
      - Key: Company
        Value: ScreenArt
      - Key: Project
        Value: MuseRelay
      - Key: Component
        Value: aws-engagement-bridge
      - Key: Environment
        Value: staging
      - Key: Purpose
        Value: hackathon
    Condition: DeployOutboundRuntime
  InboundQueuePolicy:
    Type: AWS::SQS::QueuePolicy
    Properties:
      Queues:
      - Ref: InboundQueue
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
        - Effect: Allow
          Principal:
            Service: sns.amazonaws.com
          Action: sqs:SendMessage
          Resource:
            Fn::GetAtt:
            - InboundQueue
            - Arn
          Condition:
            ArnEquals:
              aws:SourceArn:
                Ref: InboundTopic
            StringEquals:
              aws:SourceAccount:
                Ref: AWS::AccountId
  Subscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    DependsOn:
    - InboundQueuePolicy
    - DeliveryDlqPolicy
    - TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      TopicArn:
        Ref: InboundTopic
      Protocol: sqs
      Endpoint:
        Fn::GetAtt:
        - InboundQueue
        - Arn
      RawMessageDelivery: false
      RedrivePolicy:
        deadLetterTargetArn:
          Fn::GetAtt:
          - DeliveryDlq
          - Arn
  InboundLogs:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName:
        Fn::Sub: /aws/lambda/${InboundFunction}
      RetentionInDays: 7
      Tags:
      - Key: Company
        Value: ScreenArt
      - Key: Project
        Value: MuseRelay
      - Key: Component
        Value: aws-engagement-bridge
      - Key: Environment
        Value: staging
      - Key: Purpose
        Value: hackathon
    Condition: DeployRuntime
  EnqueueLogs:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName:
        Fn::Sub: /aws/lambda/${EnqueueFunction}
      RetentionInDays: 7
      Tags:
      - Key: Company
        Value: ScreenArt
      - Key: Project
        Value: MuseRelay
      - Key: Component
        Value: aws-engagement-bridge
      - Key: Environment
        Value: staging
      - Key: Purpose
        Value: hackathon
    Condition: DeployOutboundRuntime
  SenderLogs:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName:
        Fn::Sub: /aws/lambda/${SenderFunction}
      RetentionInDays: 7
      Tags:
      - Key: Company
        Value: ScreenArt
      - Key: Project
        Value: MuseRelay
      - Key: Component
        Value: aws-engagement-bridge
      - Key: Environment
        Value: staging
      - Key: Purpose
        Value: hackathon
    Condition: DeployOutboundRuntime
  DeliveryDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName:
        Fn::Sub: ${AWS::StackName}-sns-delivery-dlq
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      SqsManagedSseEnabled: true
      Tags:
      - Key: Company
        Value: ScreenArt
      - Key: Project
        Value: MuseRelay
      - Key: Component
        Value: aws-engagement-bridge
      - Key: Environment
        Value: staging
      - Key: Purpose
        Value: hackathon
  DeliveryDlqPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SQS::QueuePolicy
    Properties:
      Queues:
      - Ref: DeliveryDlq
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
        - Effect: Allow
          Principal:
            Service: sns.amazonaws.com
          Action: sqs:SendMessage
          Resource:
            Fn::GetAtt:
            - DeliveryDlq
            - Arn
          Condition:
            ArnEquals:
              aws:SourceArn:
                Ref: InboundTopic
            StringEquals:
              aws:SourceAccount:
                Ref: AWS::AccountId
  SigningSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Condition: CreateSigningSecret
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name:
        Fn::Sub: ${AWS::StackName}/signing
      Description: Dedicated Bridge signing JSON. Created without a value; populate through approved private procedure
        before enabling runtime.
      Tags:
      - Key: Company
        Value: ScreenArt
      - Key: Project
        Value: MuseRelay
      - Key: Component
        Value: aws-engagement-bridge
      - Key: Environment
        Value: staging
      - Key: Purpose
        Value: hackathon
  ArtifactBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName:
        Fn::Sub: ${AWS::StackName}-artifacts-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
        - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
            SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
        - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
        - Id: ExpireDemoArtifacts
          Status: Enabled
          ExpirationInDays: 30
          AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
            DaysAfterInitiation: 1
      Tags:
      - Key: Company
        Value: ScreenArt
      - Key: Project
        Value: MuseRelay
      - Key: Component
        Value: aws-engagement-bridge
      - Key: Environment
        Value: staging
      - Key: Purpose
        Value: hackathon
  ArtifactBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket:
        Ref: ArtifactBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
        - Sid: RequireTls
          Effect: Deny
          Principal: '*'
          Action: s3:*
          Resource:
          - Fn::GetAtt:
            - ArtifactBucket
            - Arn
          - Fn::Sub: ${ArtifactBucket.Arn}/*
          Condition:
            Bool:
              aws:SecureTransport: 'false'
              aws:PrincipalIsAWSService: 'false'
  OutboundSigningSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Condition: CreateOutboundSigningSecret
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name:
        Fn::Sub: ${AWS::StackName}/signing-outbound
      Description: Dedicated outbound-direction HMAC only; no secret value until separate initialization approval
      Tags:
      - Key: Company
        Value: ScreenArt
      - Key: Project
        Value: MuseRelay
      - Key: Component
        Value: aws-engagement-bridge
      - Key: Environment
        Value: staging
      - Key: Purpose
        Value: hackathon
  InboundFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Condition: DeployRuntime
    Properties:
      Code:
        S3Bucket:
          Ref: ArtifactBucket
        S3Key:
          Ref: RuntimeArtifactKey
      FunctionName:
        Fn::Sub: ${AWS::StackName}-inbound
      Handler: handlers.inbound
      MemorySize: 256
      Role:
        Ref: InboundExecutionRoleArn
      Runtime: nodejs22.x
      Timeout: 30
      Environment:
        Variables:
          BRIDGE_BINDINGS_JSON:
            Ref: BindingsJson
          BRIDGE_STATE_TABLE:
            Ref: State
          BRIDGE_SECRET_ARN:
            Fn::If:
            - HasExternalSecret
            - Ref: SecretArn
            - Ref: SigningSecret
          MUSERELAY_BASE_URL:
            Ref: CoreBaseUrl
          BRIDGE_LIVE_SEND:
            Ref: LiveSend
          BRIDGE_DAILY_SEND_LIMIT:
            Ref: DailySendLimit
          BRIDGE_DAILY_INBOUND_LIMIT:
            Ref: DailyInboundLimit
          META_API_VERSION:
            Ref: MetaApiVersion
          BRIDGE_RUN_ID:
            Ref: RunId
          BRIDGE_RUNTIME_ENABLED:
            Ref: ProcessingEnabled
          BRIDGE_RECEIVE_ENABLED:
            Ref: ReceiveEnabled
          BRIDGE_SEND_ENABLED:
            Ref: SendEnabled
      Tags:
      - Key: lambda:createdBy
        Value: SAM
      - Key: Company
        Value: ScreenArt
      - Key: Project
        Value: MuseRelay
      - Key: Component
        Value: aws-engagement-bridge
      - Key: Environment
        Value: staging
      - Key: Purpose
        Value: hackathon
      Architectures:
      - arm64
  InboundFunctionInput:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::EventSourceMapping
    Condition: DeployRuntime
    Properties:
      BatchSize: 1
      Enabled:
        Fn::If:
        - RunInboundConsumer
        - true
        - false
      EventSourceArn:
        Fn::GetAtt:
        - InboundQueue
        - Arn
      FunctionName:
        Ref: InboundFunction
      FunctionResponseTypes:
      - ReportBatchItemFailures
      ScalingConfig:
        MaximumConcurrency: 2
  EnqueueFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Condition: DeployOutboundRuntime
    Properties:
      Code:
        S3Bucket:
          Ref: ArtifactBucket
        S3Key:
          Ref: RuntimeArtifactKey
      FunctionName:
        Fn::Sub: ${AWS::StackName}-enqueue
      Handler: handlers.enqueue
      MemorySize: 256
      Role:
        Ref: EnqueueExecutionRoleArn
      Runtime: nodejs22.x
      Timeout: 30
      Environment:
        Variables:
          BRIDGE_BINDINGS_JSON:
            Ref: BindingsJson
          BRIDGE_STATE_TABLE:
            Ref: State
          BRIDGE_SECRET_ARN:
            Fn::If:
            - HasExternalOutboundSecret
            - Ref: OutboundSecretArn
            - Ref: OutboundSigningSecret
          MUSERELAY_BASE_URL:
            Ref: CoreBaseUrl
          BRIDGE_LIVE_SEND:
            Ref: LiveSend
          BRIDGE_DAILY_SEND_LIMIT:
            Ref: DailySendLimit
          BRIDGE_DAILY_INBOUND_LIMIT:
            Ref: DailyInboundLimit
          META_API_VERSION:
            Ref: MetaApiVersion
          BRIDGE_RUN_ID:
            Ref: RunId
          BRIDGE_RUNTIME_ENABLED:
            Ref: ProcessingEnabled
          BRIDGE_RECEIVE_ENABLED:
            Ref: ReceiveEnabled
          BRIDGE_SEND_ENABLED:
            Ref: SendEnabled
          BRIDGE_OUTBOUND_QUEUE_URL:
            Ref: OutboundQueue
      Tags:
      - Key: lambda:createdBy
        Value: SAM
      - Key: Company
        Value: ScreenArt
      - Key: Project
        Value: MuseRelay
      - Key: Component
        Value: aws-engagement-bridge
